title: Polynomial-Time Optimal Group Selection via the Double-Commutator Eigenvalue Problem
abstract: arXiv:2605.00834v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: The algebraic diversity framework generalizes temporal averaging over multiple observations to algebraic group action on a single observation for second-order statistical estimation. The central open problem in this framework is $\textit{group selection}$: given an $M$-dimensional observation with unknown covariance structure, find the finite group whose spectral decomposition best matches the covariance. Naive enumeration of all subgroups of the symmetric group $S_M$ requires exponential time in $M$. We prove that this combinatorial problem, restricted to a basis of $d$ candidate generators, reduces to a generalized eigenvalue problem derived from the double commutator of the covariance matrix, with complexity $O(d^2M^2 + d^3)$ for sparse (permutation-type) generators and $O(d^2M^3 + d^3)$ in general. translated_title: 通过双换位子特征值问题实现多项式时间的最优群选择
translated_abstract: 代数多样性框架将针对多个观测的时间平均方法推广为作用于单一观测的代数群操作，以实现二阶统计估计。该框架中的核心开放问题是群选择问题：给定一个具有未知协方差结构的 M 维观测，寻找其谱分解最能匹配该协方差的有限群。对对称群 $S_M$ 的所有子群进行朴素枚举需要关于 $M$ 的指数时间。我们证明，该组合问题在限制于由 d 个候选生成元构成的基时，可归约为由协方差矩阵的双换位子导出的广义特征值问题；对于稀疏（置换型）生成元，其复杂度为 $O(d^2M^2 + d^3)$，一般情况下为 $O(d^2M^3 + d^3)$。最小特征值对应的特征向量以闭式形式给出基张成空间内的最优生成元，无需迭代优化。
tldr: 本文证明群选择这一原本需要指数时间的组合问题可归约为由协方差矩阵双换位子导出的广义特征值问题，从而在多项式时间内以闭式解直接获得最优群生成元，无需迭代优化。
en_tdlr: This paper proves that the group selection problem, which naively requires exponential time, reduces to a generalized eigenvalue problem derived from the double commutator of the covariance matrix, enabling polynomial-time closed-form selection of the optimal group generator without iterative optimization.
